outcome: bacterial genes for bile acid metabolism
cohort: The study included 16 healthy Indian preterm infants admitted to NICU, from whom fecal samples were collected weekly from day 7 to day 30 of life.
finding: Probiotic administration and postnatal age were identified as key factors altering the gut microbial composition in healthy preterm infants, with probiotics specifically increasing Bifidobacterium levels and bacterial genes responsible for bile acid metabolism and glycosphingolipid synthesis.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a major contributor to altered microbial diversity in preterm infants.
